feedback: I liked the product, but onboarding was confusing. I did not know what to configure first after inviting my team.
The permissions screen is unclear. I cannot tell which role gives finance users access to exports.
Pricing is hard to compare. I need to understand which plan includes audit logs before I can approve the upgrade.
Bulk edits would save us a lot of time. Right now the workflow is too manual when we manage many accounts.
We are blocked because SSO setup throws an error and our security team needs this before rollout. Contact me at maya@example.com.
The setup checklist helped, but I still was not sure whether inviting teammates would notify everyone immediately.
The dashboard is useful, but I need better visibility into which teams completed setup.
Exporting reports is slow and sometimes missing the latest status. It makes it hard to trust the weekly review.
The trial is helpful, but billing by seat is unclear for contractors who only need occasional access.
Role names feel too technical. I need examples that explain what each permission actually allows.
I keep copying the same settings across workspaces. We need an automate or bulk copy option.
I was worried I would break something during setup because the product did not show a preview before applying changes.
